title: The bird on the corkboard
logline: Gully's corkboard with the bird on its top edge, among the pins: the walk map, the Florence gull, the 61 MI postcard, the yearbook photo lowest, the sticker upside down, TAKE-OUT ONLY. The bird is the only thing on the board not pinned.

panels.composition: A crowded corkboard: a hand-drawn map, a photo of a large gull, a postcard, a small yearbook photo pinned lowest, an upside-down sticker, a hand-lettered card, and the small rainbow bird perched on the board's top edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a crowded corkboard with a hand-drawn map, a photo of a large gull on a piling, a postcard, a small yearbook photo pinned lowest, an upside-down sticker and a hand-lettered card, a small rainbow bird perched on the board's top edge, no words legible
image.notes: Corkboard inventory per objects.md as of 2024. Letter TAKE-OUT ONLY after, if at all.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The only thing on the board not pinned.
